title: PaintInputStroke
description: One brush stroke over the input sample: the sampled cells in drawing order, joined by inclusive Bresenham lines, painted with one palette index. Cells outside the sample are skipped (`mutation.partial`); a stroke with no cell inside, or an index outside the palette, is `mutation.target-missing`.

description.en: The sampled cells in drawing order; consecutive points are joined by a straight line of cells.
description.de: Die abgetasteten Zellen in Zeichenreihenfolge; aufeinanderfolgende Punkte werden durch eine gerade Zellenlinie verbunden.

description.en: The palette entry the brush paints with.
description.de: Der Paletteneintrag, mit dem der Pinsel malt.
